sloka: अदितिर्मङ्गLअम् प्रादात् तत्ते भवतु मङ्गLअम् ।तीन्विक्रमान् प्रकमतो विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥२-२५-३५॥
transliteration: aditirmaṅgaLam prādāt tatte bhavatu maṅgaLam ।tīnvikramān prakamato viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ ॥2-25-35॥

translations.english: O Rama by occupying three footsteps of space, highly lustrous Visnu owned the three worlds and obtained glory. May you obtain similar auspiciousness
